name: pushnotifi
description: Human-in-the-loop for AI agents on your phone. Bundles the PushNotifi MCP server (request_ack / await_ack, send, list) and skills for wiring operational alerts and approvals via PushNotifi.me.

user_key.title: PushNotifi API key
user_key.description: Your account API key (X-API-Key) from https://pushnotifi.me/dashboard

group_key.title: Default group send_to_key
group_key.description: Optional. Group g… key (32 chars) for send/list defaults and /pushnotifi:test. Leave empty if you only use MCP with explicit send_to_key per call.

application_key.title: Application key
application_key.description: Optional. Omit to use the account default application.
